final_decision.order_rationale: noise(impulse) -> compression(jpeg): JPEG smearing of sparse spikes produces the observed colored mosquito speckle; noise energy surviving JPEG (RMSE 16.7) is only achievable when spikes precede compression; physical camera pipeline order.
final_decision.rationale: JPEG is certain (0%FP block_boundary). Residual analysis proves a sparse high-amplitude noise step: exact-255 excess 0.44% vs 0.01% clean, bright-plateau mean -14.6 with identity medians, and JPEG-only RMSE 9.1 cannot reach target 16.5. Impulse at severity 3 + JPEG quality 18 reproduces bb (1.2%), dct (0.02), wavelet sigma (exact), residual magnitude (16.70 vs 16.50) and matches on a second content (support 1). No blur (spectral slope ratio 0.972; FFT anisotropy 0), no global step (variance ratio 0.96, mean shift -1.9/255, chroma ratio 1.03; min legal contrast/brightness severities would shift var-ratio to 0.56 or mean by +25).
final_decision.residual_discrepancies: True generator darkens bright plateau slightly more than any legal x_distortion combo (target flat mean -14.6 vs -5.1 sim; global residual mean -1.9 vs +1.2..+1.4 across 5 pairs) and has fewer black outliers (any0 0.62% vs 1.17%). No legal x_distortion function reproduces this tone pull (contrast min 0.75, brightness min +10%), so it is attributed to generator implementation difference and not modeled as an extra step.
